mapper.sql: cr.id, cr.follow_task_id, cr.parent_record_id, cr.related_object_type, cr.related_object_id, case cr.related_object_type when 'CLUE' then (select full_name from t_clue where id = cr.related_object_id) when 'CUSTOMER' then (select customer_name from t_customer where id = cr.related_object_id) when 'OPPORTUNITY' then (select opportunity_no from t_opportunity where id = cr.related_object_id) when 'TEST_DRIVE' then (select test_drive_no from t_test_drive where id = cr.related_object_id) when 'ORDER' then (select tran_no from t_tran where id = cr.related_object_id) else null end as related_object_name, cr.owner_id, u.name AS owner_name, cr.communication_method, cr.communication_time, cr.summary, cr.customer_feedback, cr.next_action, cr.next_follow_time, cr.status, cr.correction_reason, cr.void_reason, cr.version, cr.create_time, cr.create_by, cr.update_time, cr.update_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_communication_record cr LEFT JOIN t_user u ON cr.owner_id = u.id WHERE cr.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM t_communication_record cr LEFT JOIN t_user u ON cr.owner_id = u.id WHERE cr.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_communication_record SET status = 'CORRECTED', correction_reason = #{correctionReason}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE t_communication_record SET status = 'VOIDED', void_reason = #{voidReason}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
